name: Battery
summary: Cylindrical battery with a plus terminal and a charge band that shows level in green, yellow or red; no brand.

params.name: y
params.note: bottom centre: the flat bottom stands on y

params.name: s
params.note: scale; at s = 1 the item is hero size (about 440 px tall); use about 0.2–0.3 next to a person

params.name: level
params.note: charge 0–1: above 0.5 green, above 0.2 yellow, otherwise red

author: krakujs
